title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Insider Trading and Disclosure of Inside Information Crimes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Typical Cases of Crimes of Insider Trading and Disclosing Inside Information

Case 1

Huang Guangyu et al. — Illegal Business Operations, Insider Trading, Disclosing Inside Information, and Unit Bribery

Defendant Huang Guangyu, male, Han ethnicity, born on May 9, 1969, former legal representative of Gome Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd., former legal representative of Beijing Pengrun Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., director of Beijing Zhongguancun Technology Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd.

Defendant Du Juan, female, Han ethnicity, born on October 25, 1972, former supervisor of Beijing Zhongguancun Technology Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd.

Defendant Xu Zhongmin, male, Han ethnicity, born on November 3, 1965, former chairman and president of Beijing Zhongguancun Technology Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd.

(I) Basic Facts

1. Facts of the crime of illegal business operations and the crime of unit bribery (omitted)

2. Facts of the crimes of insider trading and disclosing inside information

(1) In April 2007, Zhongguancun, a listed company, planned to carry out an asset swap with Pengtai Company. Huang Guangyu participated in the operation and decision-making of this major asset swap. Before the announcement of this information, Huang Guangyu decided and instructed others to borrow the identity cards of Long Yan and others, open personal stock accounts, and directly control them. Between April 27, 2007 and June 27, 2007, Huang Guangyu purchased a total of more than 9.76 million shares of Zhongguancun stock, with a total transaction amount of RMB (hereinafter the same currency) 93.1 million yuan, and a book profit of 3.48 million yuan.

(2) In July and August 2007, Zhongguancun, a listed company, planned to acquire all equity of Pengrun Holding Company for restructuring. Before the announcement of this information, Huang Guangyu instructed others to open relevant personal stock accounts using the identity cards of 79 persons including Cao Chujuan, and arranged for defendant Du Juan to assist in managing the above stock accounts. Between August 13, 2007 and September 28, 2007, Huang Guangyu instructed Du Wei and others to use the above accounts to purchase a total of more than 104 million shares of Zhongguancun stock, with a total transaction amount of 13.22 billion yuan, and a book profit of 306 million yuan.

During this period, defendant Xu Zhongmin, knowing that Huang Guangyu was using the above inside information to trade Zhongguancun stock, still accepted Huang Guangyu's instructions and directed Xu Weiming to borrow identity cards of others to open personal stock accounts or directly borrow stock accounts of others in Guangdong. Between August 13 and September 28 of the same year, Xu Zhongmin purchased a total of more than 31.66 million shares of Zhongguancun stock, with a total transaction amount of 414 million yuan, and a book profit of 90.21 million yuan.

Defendant Xu Zhongmin also intentionally disclosed the inside information of the planned restructuring of Zhongguancun, a listed company, to his wife Li Shanjuan and Xiang Huaizhu, among others. Between September 21 and 25 of the same year, Li Shanjuan purchased more than 120,000 shares of Zhongguancun stock, with a total transaction amount of over 1.81 million yuan.

(II) Judgment

The Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court held that the defendants, including Huang Guangyu, as persons who had access to inside information on securities transactions, purchased the securities before the information that had a significant impact on the securities transaction price was made public. The transaction amount and book profit of the insider trading were particularly huge, and the circumstances were particularly serious. Huang Guangyu, together with defendants Du Juan and Xu Zhongmin, constituted a joint crime of insider trading; Xu Zhongmin, by disclosing inside information to others, also constituted the crime of disclosing inside information. Among them, Huang Guangyu was the principal offender, and Du Juan and Xu Zhongmin were accessories. Accordingly, based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of social harm of the crimes committed by defendants Huang Guangyu, Du Juan, and Xu Zhongmin, the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court sentenced defendant Huang Guangyu to eight years' imprisonment for the crime of illegal business operations, with confiscation of personal property of 200 million yuan; for the crime of insider trading, to nine years' imprisonment and a fine of 600 million yuan; for the crime of unit bribery, to two years' imprisonment; the combined sentence was fourteen years' imprisonment, with a fine of 600 million yuan and confiscation of personal property of 200 million yuan. Defendant Du Juan was sentenced to three years and six months' imprisonment for the crime of insider trading, with a fine of 200 million yuan. Defendant Xu Zhongmin was sentenced to three years' imprisonment for the crimes of insider trading and disclosing inside information, with a fine of 100 million yuan; for the crime of unit bribery, to one year's imprisonment; the combined sentence was three years' imprisonment, with a fine of 100 million yuan.

Case 2

Du Lanku, Liu Naihua — Insider Trading and Disclosing Inside Information

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Du Lanku, male, born on November 29, 1956, former chief accountant of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation.

Defendant Liu Naihua, female, born on April 29, 1958, wife of defendant Du Lanku.

On March 23, 2009, Du Lanku, together with Zhang Dengzhou, director of the Finance Department of China Electronics Technology Group, inspected the 14th Research Institute and other subordinate units. Luo Qun, director of the 14th Research Institute, and Bao Weiping, deputy chief economist of the 14th Research Institute, reported to Du and Zhang about the 14th Research Institute's plan to acquire a joint-stock company in the Nanjing area for backdoor listing. On March 29, after returning to Beijing, Du Lanku searched the Internet based on the general information about the backdoor company reported by Luo and Bao, and concluded that the only company that met the backdoor conditions was Gaochun Ceramics. On March 31, during Du Lanku's accompanying of leaders of China Electronics Technology Group to attend the relocation ceremony of the 14th Research Institute, leaders of the Nanjing municipal government coordinated the acquisition and restructuring of the 14th Research Institute, making Du convinced that the company to be used for backdoor listing was Gaochun Ceramics. The next day, after returning to Beijing, Du Lanku informed his wife Liu Naihua of the information that the 14th Research Institute intended to restructure Gaochun Ceramics, and both agreed to purchase Gaochun Ceramics stock. On April 2, Du Lanku purchased 21,000 shares of Gaochun Ceramics stock through his personal account, and then gradually transferred funds from his personal account to the stock trading accounts of relatives under his control. Between April 2, 2009 and April 20, 2009, Du Lanku operated alone to purchase a total of 223,000 shares of Gaochun Ceramics stock, with a transaction amount of 1,542,185.52 yuan, and a profit of 2,470,351.38 yuan; Du Lanku and Liu Naihua jointly operated to purchase a total of 137,100 shares of Gaochun Ceramics stock, with a transaction amount of 966,946.91 yuan, and a profit of 1,739,692.46 yuan.

After learning of the information, Liu Naihua also disclosed the information of the planned restructuring of Gaochun Ceramics to Zhao Limei and others (all separately prosecuted), who subsequently purchased a total of 784,641 shares of Gaochun Ceramics stock, making a profit of 12,019,744.91 yuan.

(II) Judgment

The Wuxi Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province held that defendant Du Lanku, having obtained inside information in the course of performing his work duties, was a person who had access to inside information; defendant Liu Naihua, having learned of the inside information from her spouse, was a person who illegally obtained inside information. Before the inside information was made public, Du Lanku and Liu Naihua engaged in stock trading related to that inside information, and both the transaction amount and the profits were huge; the two defendants constituted a joint crime of insider trading. Liu Naihua also disclosed the inside information to others, causing others to engage in stock trading related to that inside information, and the circumstances were serious, thus also constituting the crime of disclosing inside information. Du Lanku played a principal role in the joint insider trading crime and was the principal offender; Liu Naihua played a secondary role and was an accessory, and thus, according to law, should be given a mitigated punishment. In light of the fact that Du Lanku and Liu Naihua had refunded all their illegal gains after the case was discovered, they could each be given a lighter punishment as appropriate. Accordingly, the Wuxi Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province sentenced defendant Du Lanku to six years' imprisonment for the crime of insider trading, with a fine of 4.25 million yuan; defendant Liu Naihua was sentenced to three years' imprisonment for the crimes of insider trading and disclosing inside information, with a fine of 4.25 million yuan.
